provenance.latin: Traditional prayers, checked against the Vatican Compendium, Appendix A; capitalization and punctuation normalized. Amen completes the Our Father.
provenance.english: Traditional English for common prayers; direct project translation from Latin for the Act of Contrition. Not a reproduction of the Compendium English translation.
provenance.timing: Estimated silent-reading durations, not recorded audio cues.
provenance.reflection: The examination prompt is an original bilingual instruction, not a traditional prayer. Automatic reading stops here until Continue is selected.
provenance.practice: A selected evening devotion, not Compline or the Divine Office.

passages.latin: In nómine Patris, et Fílii, et Spíritus Sancti. Amen.
passages.english: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

passages.latin: In siléntio, Deo grátias age et consciéntiam tuam exámina.
passages.english: In silence, give thanks to God and examine your conscience.

passages.latin: Deus meus, ex toto corde pænitet me ómnium meórum peccatórum, éaque detéstor,
passages.english: O my God, I am sorry with all my heart for all my sins, and I detest them,

passages.latin: quia peccándo, non solum pœnas a te iuste statútas proméritus sum,
passages.english: because by sinning I have not only deserved the punishments you have justly established,

passages.latin: sed præsértim quia offéndi te, summum bonum, ac dignum qui super ómnia diligáris.
passages.english: but above all because I have offended you, the highest good, worthy of being loved above all things.

passages.latin: Ídeo fírmiter propóno, adiuvánte grátia tua, de cétero me non peccatúrum peccandíque occasiónes próximas fugitúrum. Amen.
passages.english: Therefore, with the help of your grace, I firmly resolve to sin no more and to avoid the near occasions of sin. Amen.

passages.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis: sanctificétur nomen tuum;
passages.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name;

passages.latin: advéniat regnum tuum; fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo, et in terra.
passages.english: thy kingdom come; thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

passages.latin: Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie,
passages.english: Give us this day our daily bread,

passages.latin: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris.
passages.english: and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

passages.latin: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem; sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
passages.english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

passages.latin: Ave, María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum.
passages.english: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.

passages.latin: Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
passages.english: Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

passages.latin: Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
passages.english: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

passages.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
passages.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.

passages.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc et semper, et in sæcula sæculórum. Amen.
passages.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

passages.latin: Salve, Regína, mater misericórdiæ; vita, dulcédo et spes nostra, salve.
passages.english: Hail, holy Queen, Mother of mercy; hail, our life, our sweetness, and our hope.

passages.latin: Ad te clamámus, éxsules fílii Hevæ.
passages.english: To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve.

passages.latin: Ad te suspirámus, geméntes et flentes in hac lacrimárum valle.
passages.english: To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.

passages.latin: Eia ergo, advocáta nostra, illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte.
passages.english: Turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us.

passages.latin: Et Iesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui, nobis post hoc exsílium osténde.
passages.english: And after this our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

passages.latin: O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
passages.english: O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

passages.latin: Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine, et lux perpétua lúceat eis.
passages.english: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them.

passages.latin: Requiéscant in pace. Amen.
passages.english: May they rest in peace. Amen.

passages.latin: In nómine Patris, et Fílii, et Spíritus Sancti. Amen.
passages.english: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
